title: Attribute Based Interpretable Evaluation Metrics for Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated by measuring Single-attribute Divergence (SaD) and Paired-attribute Divergence (PaD) using Heterogeneous CLIPScore (HCS) for gender-specific text attributes (e.g., "man", "woman") to find representation disparities and skewed attribute correlations in generated images compared to training data.

Assessed by calculating SaD and PaD for age-specific attributes (e.g., "child", "young", "Elder") to detect whether generative models systematically over- or under-represent specific age groups relative to the original training distribution.

Quantified by comparing the probability density functions of Heterogeneous CLIPScores for various physical traits and accessories (e.g., "makeup", "eyeglasses", "bald", "beard", "skin tone") to identify distributional biases and correlation errors in generated image sets.
